tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
FeiZ opens DeepSeek Bot, letting users build teams of bots with roles and memory. Confirmed by 53AI.
Reported by 36氪: Microsoft uses Alibaba's Qwen to build decision-making models that may roll out across fields. 火山引擎 is performing a security check for user access safety.
Claude surges 770 percent in Korean job posts, outpacing other artificial intelligence tools. Reported by The Korea Times: Claude emerges as the fastest-growing artificial intelligence skill.
Anthropic bans continuous abuse of Claude, allowing exceptions for creative or research use. Reported by 新浪财经.
DeepSeek Harness can be equipped with a bot plugin to turn it into a bot system. Reported by OSCHINA.
Free every hour.
